validity_findings.finding: Effective_n subsampling uses first n elements by DOM position, not random subsets. Early DOM positions are header/form/navigation elements (tags A, FORM, DIV, LABEL, SPAN, INPUT, BUTTON) with different matching rates (1/5 at n=5, 3/10 at n=10, 5/15 vs 4/15 listing vs detail at n=15, 8/20 vs 5/20 at n=20). This preserves DOM-sequential structure but biases discriminative signal vs random sampling and limits extrapolation to full DOM n=21-82. Producer discloses this as CRITICAL LIMITATION in spec measurement_validity 8-9 and validity_notes bullet 4.

validity_findings.finding: C5 Spearman correlation computed on only 4 points (5,10,15,20) with tied agreement values (0.0 at n=5 and n=10). Producer code uses rank via sorted().index() without averaging ties, yielding Spearman=1.0. Correct tie-averaged Spearman (average rank 0.5 for both zeros) is 0.9486, still >=0.6. Improvement criterion (0.5595 >=0.10) also holds. Finding does not change PASS for C5 but indicates small-n low statistical power disclosed in validity_notes bullet 6.

validity_findings.finding: Bootstrap at each n resamples tasks within type and draws one canonical recipe iteration per bootstrap. High std ~0.50 (57.1% +-49.5% at n=20) therefore conflates task-sampling variance with recipe-sampling variance, not pure task uncertainty. Bootstrap CI spanning ~0-100% correctly signals ranking instability but is not a pure sampling CI for non-recipe ranking. Producer reports mean +- std and discloses high variance interpretation without overclaiming precision.

claim_ceiling: Maximum justified: On truncated-first-20 locatable_sample from single Magento localhost site (7 tasks: 3 product_listing ewb 1550/1560/1564, 3 detail ewb 1215/1149/1143, 1 cart ewb 1070, within-type template-identical tags/roles/inForm), feature-weighted density sum(feature_value)/elements_with_bbox through OECD/COINr non-recipe pipeline preserves between-type discrimination (max eta2 0.999645 at n=20) and preserves listing>detail ranking for tag_entropy at n>=15 for both DEF-FULL-MAP (a->link,input->textbox) and DEF-FORM-ONLY, but reverses at n<=10 due to ewb denominator dominance. Under recipe sampling (p=0.5), canonical shared-subset ranking agreement for tag_entropy x DEF-FULL-MAP improves monotonically from 0% at n=5/10 to 50% at n=15 to 55.95% at n=20 (Spearman 1.0 reported, 0.95 tie-corrected, +55.95pp improvement, C5 PASS) but plateaus below 80% threshold (C6 FAIL, 55.95% <80% with bootstrap 57.1% +-49.5%). Per-task independent recipe reaches 78.65% at n=20 (<80%) with lower eta2 0.37. Ranking instability is partially sample-size-dependent but not resolved at maximum available n=20; recipe-sampling destabilization is structural within this sample range. No inference to full DOM n=21-82, other sites, true DOM depth, or production MIXED handling warranted. Product lane must use non-recipe density only; do not promote recipe-based density.
